verses.text: [Put] the trumpet to your lips! Like an eagle [the enemy comes] against the house of the LORD, Because they have transgressed My covenant And rebelled against My law.
verses.textZh: 你用口吹角罷！敵人如鷹來攻打耶和華的家；因為這民違背我的約，干犯我的律法。

verses.text: They cry out to Me, 'My God, we of Israel know You!'
verses.textZh: 他們必呼叫我說：我的神啊，我們以色列認識你了。

verses.text: Israel has rejected the good; The enemy will pursue him.
verses.textZh: 以色列丟棄良善（或譯：福分）；仇敵必追逼他。

verses.text: They have set up kings, but not by Me; They have appointed princes, but I did not know [it]. With their silver and gold they have made idols for themselves, That they might be cut off.
verses.textZh: 他們立君王，卻不由我；他們立首領，我卻不認。他們用金銀為自己製造偶像，以致被剪除。

verses.text: He has rejected your calf, O Samaria, [saying], 'My anger burns against them!' How long will they be incapable of innocence?
verses.textZh: 撒瑪利亞啊，耶和華已經丟棄你的牛犢；我的怒氣向拜牛犢的人發作。他們到幾時方能無罪呢？

verses.text: For from Israel is even this! A craftsman made it, so it is not God; Surely the calf of Samaria will be broken to pieces.
verses.textZh: 這牛犢出於以色列，是匠人所造的，並不是神。撒瑪利亞的牛犢必被打碎。

verses.text: For they sow the wind And they reap the whirlwind. The standing grain has no heads; It yields no grain. Should it yield, strangers would swallow it up.
verses.textZh: 他們所種的是風，所收的是暴風；所種的不成禾稼，就是發苗也不結實；即便結實，外邦人必吞吃。

verses.text: Israel is swallowed up; They are now among the nations Like a vessel in which no one delights.
verses.textZh: 以色列被吞吃；現今在列國中，好像人不喜悅的器皿。

verses.text: For they have gone up to Assyria, [Like] a wild donkey all alone; Ephraim has hired lovers.
verses.textZh: 他們投奔亞述，如同獨行的野驢；以法蓮賄買朋黨。

verses.text: Even though they hire [allies] among the nations, Now I will gather them up; And they will begin to diminish Because of the burden of the king of princes.
verses.textZh: 他們雖在列邦中賄買人，現在我卻要聚集懲罰他們；他們因君王和首領所加的重擔日漸衰微。

verses.text: Since Ephraim has multiplied altars for sin, They have become altars of sinning for him.
verses.textZh: 以法蓮增添祭壇取罪；因此，祭壇使他犯罪。

verses.text: Though I wrote for him ten thousand [precepts] of My law, They are regarded as a strange thing.
verses.textZh: 我為他寫了律法萬條，他卻以為與他毫無關涉。

verses.text: As for My sacrificial gifts, They sacrifice the flesh and eat [it], [But] the LORD has taken no delight in them. Now He will remember their iniquity, And punish [them] for their sins; They will return to Egypt.
verses.textZh: 至於獻給我的祭物，他們自食其肉，耶和華卻不悅納他們。現在必記念他們的罪孽，追討他們的罪惡；他們必歸回埃及。

verses.text: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; And Judah has multiplied fortified cities, But I will send a fire on its cities that it may consume its palatial dwellings.
verses.textZh: 以色列忘記造他的主，建造宮殿；猶大多造堅固城，我卻要降火焚燒他的城邑，燒滅其中的宮殿。
